title: Duckling holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff176'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd54f'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='headGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff59d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffca28'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='heartGrad' cx='40%' cy='30%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5252'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d32f2f'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='22' ry='20' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- wing left -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='65' rx='9' ry='13' fill='#ffe082' transform='rotate(-15,31,65)'/>

  <!-- wing right -->
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='65' rx='9' ry='13' fill='#ffe082' transform='rotate(15,69,65)'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='18' fill='url(#headGrad)'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='47' r='4' fill='#ffab91' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='47' r='4' fill='#ffab91' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#1a1a1a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#1a1a1a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='39' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='39' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M46 47 Q50 52 54 47 Q50 49 46 47Z' fill='#ff8f00'/>
  <path d='M46 47 Q50 45 54 47 Q50 49 46 47Z' fill='#ffb300'/>

  <!-- little tuft on head -->
  <path d='M48 25 Q50 20 52 25 Q50 23 48 25Z' fill='#ffca28'/>
  <path d='M53 26 Q56 21 57 27 Q55 25 53 26Z' fill='#ffca28'/>

  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M40 87 Q38 92 34 92 Q36 87 40 87Z' fill='#ff8f00'/>
  <path d='M40 87 Q40 92 36 93 Q38 88 40 87Z' fill='#ffa726'/>
  <path d='M60 87 Q62 92 66 92 Q64 87 60 87Z' fill='#ff8f00'/>
  <path d='M60 87 Q60 92 64 93 Q62 88 60 87Z' fill='#ffa726'/>
  <rect x='38' y='86' width='4' height='4' rx='1' fill='#ff8f00'/>
  <rect x='58' y='86' width='4' height='4' rx='1' fill='#ff8f00'/>

  <!-- heart held between wings -->
  <path d='M50 74 
           C50 74 38 64 38 57 
           C38 51 44 50 47 54 
           C48 55 49 57 50 59 
           C51 57 52 55 53 54 
           C56 50 62 51 62 57 
           C62 64 50 74 50 74Z' 
        fill='url(#heartGrad)' stroke='#ef5350' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- heart shine -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='57' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ffcdd2' opacity='0.7' transform='rotate(-30,43,57)'/>
</svg>
